{{Quote|This tank is a ''Baktoid Armour Workshop'' model&mdash;the main power source is somewhere in the ''rear''.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Burn">{{TCWComicCite|6.17|Burn the Behemoth!}}</ref>}}
Prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], '''Baktoid Armor Workshop''' was a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]-owned design firm that specialized in developing rugged all-terrain ground vehicles for use by civilians. [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] was one of Baktoid's executive officers. [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]] was an acquaintance of Baktoid's chief designer, a man who was obsessed with tanks.

A Baktoid design tended to be heavily armored, with delicate or important components placed in secure, well protected areas near the rear of the craft. Early Baktoid vehicles were rarely manufactured with weapons, but they did possess standard weapons emplacements allowing combat modifications to be made after purchase.

==History==
[[File:MTTCIS-SWE.png|thumb|left|220px|A Baktoid MTT painted with the colors of the CIS]]
In order to build its secret army, the Trade Federation provided Baktoid with funding for a complete line of ground assault vehicles and transports. It is also rumored that the Trade Federation arranged a merger between Baktoid and [[Haor Chall Engineering/Legends|Haor Chall]] arms merchants, although Baktoid denied this claim. Nevertheless, with the Trade Federation's support, Baktoid began work on several new craft, including the fearsome [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] and the nearly unstoppable [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transport]]. During development of these vehicles, the company made a conscious effort to adhere to a unified design style, resulting in a line of vehicles reminiscent of large and dangerous animals.

After the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the Trade Federation tried to distance itself from the Baktoid Armor Workshop, which was accused of providing the front line assault vehicles used in the capture of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] and other settlements. The Trade Federation dramatically dissolved Baktoid, only to quietly transfer many of the company's manufacturing facilities and designs to other Trade Federation subsidiaries, including the [[Judicial Department/Legends|illicit]] [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]] and [[Baktoid Fleet Ordnance/Legends|Baktoid Fleet Ordnance]]. Baktoid products and vehicles would form most of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] military during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Shortly before the Clone Wars, Baktoid sponsored an effort to transport a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] hive to [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]], where they built a droid factory, producing troops for the incoming war.

==Traits==
Most of the Baktoid Armor Workshop's products' main power systems were located in the rear of the craft.
